verdict.rationale: Qualcomm's own AI stack targets this silicon. The developer portal documents the Qualcomm AI Engine Direct SDK and AI Hub for deploying models to the Hexagon NPU on Snapdragon X-series PCs. AI Hub converts models to ONNX Runtime, LiteRT or Qualcomm AI Runtime, and GenieX offers a unified runtime across NPU, GPU and CPU. Missing for 10: X2 Elite Extreme-specific runtime support docs (the evidence covers X-series generally), any evidence of llama.cpp or MLX support, and independent hands-on confirmation that these runtimes work on X2 hardware.
